title: Gerrie Road subdivision and 2024 budget planning
subtitle: Land needs review, cannabis retail referral, Clyde Street odour control contract, source water changes, and capital forecast.
overview: The Committee of the Whole recommended that Council adopt a Township-initiated Official Plan Amendment, support draft approval of a subdivision at 6542 and 6560 Gerrie Road in Elora, and approve the related rezoning {{vote:m4}}. Staff described a mix of single detached homes and multi-unit buildings, with 248 proposed units.

On the budget, the committee recommended including the 10-year capital forecast {{vote:m7}} and the debt requirements and capacity report {{vote:m8}} in the Draft 2024 Budget. It also recommended a single source contract for odour control at the Clyde Street Wastewater Pumping Station {{vote:m6}}, with a small additional amount from the Wastewater Capital Reserve.

The committee referred cannabis retail storefronts to the Economic Prosperity & Growth Advisory Committee {{vote:m5}}. It received the land needs review presentation {{vote:m2}} and the source water report {{vote:m3}} for information. Several budget and financial reports were also received for information. Nothing was reported from the closed session on land matters. Council must still adopt these recommendations.

decisions.detail: The committee recommended Council adopt the Official Plan Amendment, recommend draft plan approval of subdivision 23T-18002 to the County, and approve rezoning RZ06/18.

The committee recommended a single source award to Environmental & Power Solutions Inc. at an upset limit of $383,007 including non-rebate HST, plus $1,500 from the Wastewater Capital Reserve for overage.
The committee recommended including the 2024 to 2033 capital forecast in the Draft 2024 Budget.
The committee recommended including the debt requirements and capacity report in the Draft 2024 Budget.
The committee referred the matter to the Economic Prosperity & Growth Advisory Committee for review and a report back to Council.
The committee received the Watson and Associates presentation on the Centre Wellington land needs review for information.
